title: macOS blackboxd/bro-harness redeploy (stablesign + launchd)
content: macOS host binaries (collectors, fleetd, bro-harness, bro) redeploy with the operator's stablesign helper (shell alias `stablesign`), never ad-hoc `codesign -f -s -`: it signs with a persistent self-signed codesigning identity from the login keychain, so the designated requirement is stable across binary swaps and TCC privacy grants (notably network volumes, where an invalidated grant makes git/fs calls on automounts hang silently) and launchd's cached LWCR survive redeploys. Flow: back up the prior binary to `.bak`, copy the new binary into ~/.local/bin, `stablesign` it, then `launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/<label>` for launchd-managed satellites (bootout/bootstrap only as a fallback). If a satellite goes quiet after a signing change, check System Settings for a pending TCC consent. KeepAlive{SuccessfulExit:false}: a clean exit 0 is not auto-restarted.
